comment: Builds the dual-use shared/*.ts sources to committed CommonJS+global shared/*.js (npm run build:shared), emitting each .js next to its .ts. Separate from the client tsconfig because these need Node's `module` global and emit, where the client config is DOM-only + noEmit. The .js outputs are committed so a plain `node server.js` deploy needs no build step; check:shared-fresh guards them against drift.
